_doc: Walks to a goal (generated by tools/trails/goal_walks.py from OpenStreetMap, ODbL, and the Copernicus DEM; never edit by hand).

trails.name: Cerro Las Tórtolas
trails.why: Cerro Las Tórtolas is a mountain in the Andes Mountains, on the border between Argentina and Chile.

trails.name: Marmolejo summit
trails.why: Volcán Marmolejo is a 6,108 m high Pleistocene stratovolcano in the Andes on the border between Argentina and Chile.

trails.name: Licancabur summit
trails.why: Licancabur is a stratovolcano on the border between Bolivia and Chile, beside the Laguna Verde.

trails.name: El Plomo summit
trails.why: Cerro El Plomo is a mountain in the Andes near Santiago, Chile. With an elevation of 5,434 m, it is the largest peak visible from Santiago on clear days.

trails.name: Cerro Pintor
trails.why: Cerro Pintor is a mountain of the central Andes east of Santiago.

trails.name: Cumbre Oeste summit
trails.why: Planchón is an active 3,977 m volcano on the border between Argentina and Chile.

trails.name: Planchón-Peteroa summit
trails.why: Planchón-Peteroa is a complex volcano extending in a north-south direction along the border between Argentina and Chile.

trails.name: Cerro de Ramón
trails.why: Cerro San Ramón is the highest foothill of the Andes facing the city of Santiago.

trails.name: Cerro Punta de Damas
trails.why: Cerro Punta de Damas is a foothill of the Andes, the second-highest facing the city of Santiago.

trails.name: Llaima summit
trails.why: The Llaima Volcano is one of the largest and most active volcanoes in Chile. It is situated 82 km northeast of Temuco and 663 km southeast of Santiago, within the borders of Conguillío National Park.

trails.name: Antuco summit
trails.why: Antuco Volcano is a stratovolcano located in the Bío Bío Region of Chile, near Sierra Velluda and on the shore of Laguna del Laja.

trails.name: Copahue summit
trails.why: Copahue is a volcano on the border between Argentina and Chile.

trails.name: Osorno Volcano summit
trails.why: Osorno Volcano is a 2,652-metre tall conical stratovolcano lying between Osorno Province and Llanquihue Province, in Los Lagos Region of Chile.

trails.name: Mocho-Choshuenco summit
trails.why: Mocho-Choshuenco is a glacier covered compound stratovolcano in the Andes of Los Ríos Region, Chile.

trails.name: Quetrupillán summit
trails.why: Quetrupillán is a stratovolcano located in the La Araucanía Region of Chile. It is situated between Villarrica and Lanín volcanoes, within Villarrica National Park.

trails.name: Sollipulli summit
trails.why: Sollipulli is an ice-filled volcanic caldera and volcanic complex, which lies southeast of the small town of Melipeuco in the La Araucanía Region, Chile.

trails.name: Puyehue-Cordón Caulle summit
trails.why: Puyehue and Cordón Caulle are two coalesced volcanic edifices that form a major mountain massif in Puyehue National Park in the Andes of Ranco Province, in the South of Chile.

trails.name: Casablanca summit
trails.why: Casablanca is a holocene stratovolcano in the Andes of Los Lagos Region, Chile. It is located about 90 km east of the city of Osorno and host on its slopes the Antillanca ski resort.

trails.name: Cerro Alto de las Vizcachas

points.name: Cerro Alto de las Vizcachas, 1,871 m

trails.why: Cerro Alto de las Vizcachas is a foothill of the Andes, one of the most visited weekend hikes of Santiago.

trails.name: Cerro Bustamante
trails.why: Cerro Bustamante is a mountain of the Coastal Range on the west side of the Santiago region, visible from all over the city.

trails.name: Cerro Poqui
trails.why: Cerro Poqui is a hill in the O'Higgins region, between Coltauco and Doñihue.

trails.name: Cerro Pochoco
trails.why: Cerro Pochoco is a foothill of the Andes at El Arrayán in Lo Barnechea, near the Mapocho river.

trails.name: Cerro Manquehue
trails.why: Cerro Manquehue is the highest hill of the Santiago valley, on the border of Huechuraba, Lo Barnechea and Vitacura.

trails.name: Cerro Lo Aguirre
trails.why: Cerro Lo Aguirre is an island hill of the Santiago region, between Pudahuel and Maipú.

trails.name: Mount Tarn
trails.why: Mount Tarn is a small mountain located on the southernmost part of the Strait of Magellan, in Brunswick Peninsula, about 70 km south of Punta Arenas, Chile.

trails.name: Cerro Mauco
trails.why: Cerro Mauco is a 725 m hill on the north bank of the lower Aconcagua river, 17 km north-east of Concón.

trails.name: Laguna El Manco
trails.why: Laguna Manco is a small lake in the east of Tucapel, Biobío region, and the source of the Manco river.
